learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will master the precise format, formal tone, and conciseness required to draft official notices within the strict 50-word limit.]
warm_up_hook: 📢 Imagine you need to announce a sudden school trip to 500 students, but you only have 50 words to do it! Welcome to the art of Notice Writing—where every single word counts! 📝

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A notice must always be enclosed in a BOX. The top center contains the Name of the Issuing Authority/Institution, followed by the word 'NOTICE' (capitalized). Then comes the Date (left-aligned), an eye-catching Heading, the Body, and finally the Signature, Name, and Designation of the issuer.
examples_or_templates: Format Flow: [BOX] -> INSTITUTION NAME -> NOTICE -> Date -> HEADING -> Body -> Sign/Name/Designation

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The body of the notice must answer five crucial questions: What is happening? Where is it happening? When is it happening (date and time)? Who can participate/attend? Whom to contact for further details? All this must be done in under 50 words.
examples_or_templates: Targeted phrasing: 'An inter-school debate competition is being organized on 5th Nov 2026, from 9 AM at the School Auditorium.'
Closing standard: 'For further details, contact the undersigned.'

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Notices are formal announcements. Use the passive voice wherever possible. Never use first-person pronouns like 'I' or 'We'. Instead of 'I am informing you', use 'This is to inform all students'.
examples_or_templates: Incorrect: I want to tell you about a meeting.
Correct: This is to inform all members about a meeting.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following is an absolute MUST for a formal Notice?
options: It must be written in the first person.
It must be enclosed in a box.
It must include the principal's signature.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: It must be enclosed in a box.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ How should the word 'NOTICE' be written?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ You are the Head Boy/Girl of XYZ Public School. Draft a notice in not more than 50 words informing students of Classes 11 and 12 about a Career Counseling Workshop.
subjective_practice.hint: Remember the 5 Ws: Mention the date, time, venue, and whom to contact for registration. Don't forget the box!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Correct the error in this notice intro: 'I am writing this notice to tell everyone that our school is organizing a fair.'
subjective_practice.hint: Shift from first-person active voice to third-person formal/passive voice.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🛑 The 50-Word Challenge
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draft a notice for a fictional 'Zombie Apocalypse Survival Drill' at your school. You must include all the necessary details (time, venue, what to bring) and keep it strictly under 50 words. Put it in a box!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A box is mandatory, and the word limit is strictly 50 words.
⭐ The format must include Institution Name, 'NOTICE', Date, Heading, Body, and Issuer details.
⭐ Always answer the 5 Ws and maintain a formal, third-person tone (passive voice).
